contentItem.title: 性质与证明：平行六面体与平行线与比例
contentItem.englishTitle: If four straight lines be proportional, the parallelepipedal solids on them which are similar and similarly described will also be proportional; and, if the parallelepipedal solids on them which are similar and similarly described be proportional, the straight lines will themselves also be proportional.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: If four straight lines be proportional, the parallelepipedal solids on them which are similar and similarly described will also be proportional; and, if the parallelepipedal solids on them which are similar and similarly described be proportional, the straight lines will themselves also be proportional.
如果四条直线为成比例, 其上类似和类似描述的平行管道固体也将是成比例;如果其上类似和类似描述的平行管道固体为成比例, 则直线本身也将是成比例。

Let AB, CD, EF, GH be four straight lines in proportion, so that, as AB is to CD, so is EF to GH; and let there be described on AB, CD, EF, GH the similar and similarly situated parallelepipedal solids KA, LC, ME, NG; I say that, as KA is to LC, so is ME to NG.
让AB、CD、EF、GH等分四个直线,AB至CD等分,等于EF至GH;AB、CD、EF、GH等分,类似和类似平行的平行管道固体KA、LC、ME、NG;KA至LC等分,等于ME至NG等分；AB 与 CD 之比等于 EF 与 GH 之比；KA 与 LC 之比等于 ME 与 NG 之比。
For, since the parallelepipedal solid KA is similar to LC, therefore KA has to LC the ratio triplicate of that which AB has to CD. [[XI. 33](/principles/euclid-11-33)]
因为平行管道固体KA类似LC,因此KA的比例为AB比CD之比的三倍。 [[XI. 33](/principles/euclid-11-33)]
For the same reason ME also has to NG the ratio triplicate of that which EF has to GH. [id.]
出于同样原因,ME的比例也达到NG,EF的比例为GH。
And, as AB is to CD, so is EF to GH.
AB比CD等于EF比GH；AB 与 CD 之比等于 EF 与 GH 之比。
Therefore also, as AK is to LC, so is ME to NG.
因此,AK比LC的比例也等于ME比NG；AK 与 LC 之比等于 ME 与 NG 之比。
Next, as the solid AK is to the solid LC, so let the solid ME be to the solid NG; I say that, as the straight line AB is to CD, so is EF to GH.
其次,由于AK固体是LC固体,因此,ME固体是NG固体;我说,AB直线对CD直线的比例等于EF对GH。

For since, again, KA has to LC the ratio triplicate of that which AB has to CD, [[XI. 33](/principles/euclid-11-33)] and ME also has to NG the ratio triplicate of that which EF has to GH, [id.] and, as KA is to LC, so is ME to NG, therefore also, as AB is to CD, so is EF to GH.
KA比LC,AB比CD,ME比NG,EF比GH,KA比GH,LC等于ME比NG,AB比AB比CD,AB比GH；KA 与 LC 之比等于 ME 与 NG 之比；AB 与 CD 之比等于 EF 与 GH 之比。 [[XI. 33](/principles/euclid-11-33)]
